Its stated prerequisites are "Xcode installed with command-line tools", "XcodeBuildMCP MCP server connected", and "At least one iOS Simulator available", and it hard-stops otherwise: "Do NOT proceed until XcodeBuildMCP is confirmed working." This is a Linux Go project with no Apple surface; `xcodebuild` is absent. Irrelevant platform, no plausible use.
